title: In praise of human teachers: universities must resist outsourcing everything to AI
title_zh: 赞颂人类教师：大学必须抵制将一切外包给人工智能
abstract: An AI revolution is sweeping through education. But teachers who can convey the excitement of thinking and learning are irreplaceable.
abstract_zh: 人工智能革命正在席卷教育领域。然而，能够传递思考与学习兴奋感的教师是不可替代的。
